text: Cohesion is how well the members of a group stick together and work as one team. Scientists think yawning may help animals feel close, which keeps their group tightly bound.
To diminish something is to make it smaller or weaker. Living with people seems to have made dogs notice other dogs a little less.
Trifling means very small and not important. Losing a catchy yawn sounds trifling, but the scientist fears it could lead to bigger changes.
Contagious means able to spread from one person or animal to another. A cold is contagious, and in this article so is a yawn.
Mimicry is copying the way someone else looks, sounds, or acts. When one animal yawns right after another, that is mimicry.
Chimpanzees are large, clever apes that live in groups in Africa. They are among our closest animal relatives.
Elephants are the biggest land animals. They live in close family herds.
Allegedly means that people say something is true but it has not been proven. Here, parrots are said to catch yawns, but nobody is sure.
A purpose is the reason something exists or is done. Scientists still do not know the purpose of yawning.
If something remains unclear, people still do not understand it. Why animals catch yawns is still a mystery.
Here, to suspect means to think something is probably true without being sure. Many scientists suspect that yawns help animals bond.
Mirroring means copying what someone else does, like a mirror does. Animals might mirror each other to feel closer.
To strengthen something is to make it stronger. Yawning may strengthen the friendship between two animals.
A social bond is a close tie between two animals or people, like friendship or family. Bonds help groups stay together.
Wolf-descended means born from a long line of wolves. All dogs are descended from wolves.
Canids are members of the dog family, such as dogs, wolves, and foxes.
Man's Best Friend is a nickname for the dog, because dogs have been loyal helpers to people for so long.
Evolutionary describes slow changes in living things over many generations. Evolution happens over thousands of years, not in one lifetime.
Transferred means moved from one place or one owner to another. Here, the job of yawning for friendship moved from dog to human.
To investigate is to look closely to find out the facts. The scientists watched wolves to investigate yawning.
A purebred animal has parents who are both the same kind. A purebred wolf has only wolf parents.
A crossbreed has parents of two different kinds. Here, the crossbreeds had both wolf and dog in their family.
DNA is the set of instructions inside every living thing that helps decide how its body and behavior turn out.
Domestication is when people live with a kind of animal for a very long time and choose which ones have young, so the animals slowly change.
Bred means chosen by people to have babies so the young have certain traits. Dogs were bred to be friendly and helpful.
Traits are features of how a living thing looks or acts, like being calm or being fast.
To migrate usually means to travel from one place to another. Here, dog DNA is moving into wolf groups, like a traveler.
Genes are small parts of DNA that carry one set of instructions for how a body grows or acts.
Wilderness enclosures are large fenced areas of wild land where animals live, so scientists can watch them.
Captive means kept in a place and not free to leave. The wolves lived in large fenced areas.
A generation is one step in a family line: parents, then their children, then grandchildren.
A session is a set period of time for one activity. Each wolf was watched for 22 sessions of 15 minutes.
Studiously means in a careful, serious way. The scientists carefully wrote down every yawn.
Striking means so clear or surprising that you notice it. The findings were striking because the gap was large.
To follow suit means to do the same thing someone else just did. A wolf that yawned right after another followed suit.
Copycatting means copying what someone else does. Here, it means catching a yawn.
Genetically means caused by genes passed down from parents. A genetically evolved trait is built into the animal's DNA.
A phenomenon is something that happens and can be observed, like a rainbow or a yawn spreading.
Intriguingly means in a way that makes you curious. It introduces a surprising finding.
A position of power is a leader's spot in a group. The pack's bosses were not the ones who started yawns.
Socialites are people or animals who spend time with many others. Here, they are the most friendly and well-connected wolves.
Packmates are wolves in the same pack, the group they live and hunt with.
Primates are the group of animals that includes monkeys, apes, and humans.
Bonobos are apes that look like small chimpanzees. They live in Africa and are very social.
Crucial means extremely important. A crucial factor is one that really matters.
A population is all the animals of one kind living in an area. A wild wolf population is all the wolves there.
A conservationist works to protect animals, plants, and nature. Dr Amici wants to protect wolves.
Adverse means harmful or unfavorable. Adverse consequences are bad results.
A consequence is a result of something that happened. Actions can have good or bad consequences.
Subtle means small and hard to notice. Subtle changes in behavior are easy to miss.
Behavioural means about how an animal acts. This is the British spelling of behavioral.
A cascade is a chain of events where one thing causes the next, like falling dominoes. Small changes can cascade into large ones.
Profound means very deep and important. A profound change affects many things.
Ecological means about how living things and their surroundings fit together. Ecological changes affect plants, animals, and their homes.
Repercussions are the effects that follow after something happens, usually unwelcome ones.
To disrupt is to interrupt or break up something that normally works. Dog DNA could disrupt how wolves live together.
Biology is the study of living things. A wolf's biology means how its body and instincts work.
Coordination is working together smoothly toward a goal. Wolves need it to hunt as a team.
Offspring are the young that an animal has, such as pups.
To tire of something means to get bored or fed up with it. If wolves tired of each other, packs could fall apart.
Putting on a hat means speaking in a certain role. As a conservationist, she thinks about protecting wolves.
Federica Amici is a scientist at the Max Planck Institute in Germany who studies animal behavior and led this wolf study.
Paolo Ciucci is an Italian scientist from La Sapienza University in Rome who studies wolves and worked on this study.
